title.narrative: UNICEF Maldives’ Communications and Advocacy strategy achieved a social media reach of over 250,000. Key digital content was co-created with Climate Guardians and girls. High-level advocacy and youth-led initiatives were strengthened. MCO raised USD 6.5 million for education. Private sector engagement and national events reached 2,117 children and youth.
